claim_under_pricing: Does the flagged constant-velocity crosser axis create type-(b) regions where a reveal-constrained per-instance oracle succeeds but the best disjoint-selection reflex-family arm fails because moving-obstacle timing/prediction is required?
claim_boundary: B1b moving-obstacle pricing measurement only: scripted reflex baselines, a nominal/no-spread inert RLS arm, a disjoint-selection per-cell tuned reflex upper bound, and a reveal-constrained privileged oracle compared on flagged constant-velocity crosser scenarios. Zero training; no incumbent driver mutation, validation ranking, promotion, driver-performance, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim. Quick mode is protocol smoke only and is not a pricing verdict.

scenario_panel.placement_rule: Initial lateral offset is chosen so the crosser is near the ego lane at nominal arrival, with row jitter; obstacle labels are re-derived with obstacle_lateral_velocity and predicted_lateral_offset_at_arrival.

arms.fixed_v4_incumbent: canonical M3105 v4-v2 fallback hard-safety direct-action reflex, used as a secondary incumbent transfer readout
arms.fixed_star: one global 27-grid reflex retune selected on pooled selection rows only
arms.v4_rls: nominal/no-spread inert arm identical to fixed_star; B1b varies obstacle timing rather than vehicle population parameters, so no honest vehicle RLS signal exists on this panel
arms.v4_pertuned: per-cell 27-grid reflex winner selected on disjoint selection rows only
arms.oracle: reveal-constrained privileged tail search after the obstacle is visible under fixed_star; structured candidates first, then CEM fallback

preregistered_readouts.primary_prize: oracle - v4_pertuned success rate on the oracle-solved denominator
preregistered_readouts.secondary_floor_gap: oracle - fixed_star success rate on the oracle-solved denominator
preregistered_readouts.classical_residual: v4_pertuned - v4_rls success rate; because v4_rls is inert on this panel, this also reports the per-cell tuning lift over fixed_star
preregistered_readouts.oracle_denominator: Rows where the reveal-constrained oracle solves are included in the primary denominator; oracle-infeasible rows are excluded and reported separately.

quick_decision_rule: Accept M3239 quick protocol smoke iff the script exercises two cells, disjoint selection/validation seeds, finite dynamic moving-obstacle rows, all validation rows reveal the obstacle under fixed_star, every validation row attempts oracle search, and each row either reaches CEM coverage or is solved by structured search. Quick mode is not a B1b pricing verdict.
decision_rule: B1b full pricing is positive iff >=2 full-panel cells have oracle_minus_pertuned >= 0.15 with paired bootstrap CI95 lower > 0 on the oracle-solved denominator. Either verdict feeds the roadmap and papers; no training is admitted by this artifact alone.
runtime_gates: composed_action must match the canonical v4 function bit-for-bit on random obs72 samples
selection and validation seeds must be disjoint
all probe rows must use constant_velocity_crosser with nonzero obstacle_lateral_velocity and finite predicted_lateral_offset_at_arrival
quick smoke must pass before a full pricing run is interpreted
